rawContent: Like, riddle me this, Twitter. Is there a reason why The Washington Post and the New York Times are publishing articles about "evangelicalism's #metoo moment" without saying #churchtoo? Especially considering the role the tag played in the Andy Savage case?

RIGHT. #ChurchToo wouldn't exist without #MeToo. We owe it all to @TaranaBurke & all the brave women everywhere who have shared their stories and that INCLUDES the church. #ChurchToo is just #MeToo applied to faith communities and considering the particular unique issues present https://t.co/oKpoQ3IUJm

Like for example. You don't have Harvey Weinstein telling women "God told me it's okay to do this" or justifying his actions with chapters and verses from the Bible. Those are some #MeToo issues unique to churches/Christian schools etc. But that doesn't make #ChurchToo separate.

If you feel a need to place a false dichotomy between #MeToo and #ChurchToo so you can affirm one while you ignore or demonize the other that says more about you and your need to look like you have the moral high ground than anything about us or the movements.
